facts.statement: The holotype fossil of Graciliraptor was discovered in Beipiao, Liaoning Province, China.
facts.quote: Its fossil, holotype IVPP V 13474, was found in Beipiao, Liaoning Province, China.

facts.statement: Graciliraptor was named and described in 2004 by Xu Xing and Wang Xiaoling.
facts.quote: named and described in 2004 by Xu Xing and Wang Xiaoling.

facts.statement: Graciliraptor is a genus of microraptorian dromaeosaurid dinosaur meaning "graceful thief".
facts.quote: Graciliraptor (meaning "graceful thief") is a genus of microraptorian dromaeosaurid dinosaur

facts.statement: Graciliraptor is estimated to have been about 90 centimeters long in life.
facts.quote: It is estimated to have been about 90 cm long in life.

facts.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated Graciliraptor to be one meter long and weigh 1.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul gave higher estimations of one metre and 1.5 kilogrammes.

facts.statement: The femur of Graciliraptor is thirteen centimeters long, and its total body length was estimated at one meter.
facts.quote: The femur is thirteen centimetres long and total body length was estimated at one metre.

facts.statement: A thin bone sheath connects the posterior articular processes of Graciliraptor's tail vertebrae, extending over an eighth of the following vertebra to stiffen the middle tail.
facts.quote: The posterior articular processes of the tail vertebrae, or postzygapophyses, are connected by a thin bone sheath or lamina, that extends to the back over an eighth of the centrum of the following vertebra, thus further stiffening the middle tail, already immobilised by the typical dromaeosaurid long prezygapophyses.

facts.statement: Graciliraptor fossils are found in the lowest portions of the Yixian Formation, specifically the Lujiatun Member.
facts.quote: Graciliraptor has been found in the lowest portions of the Yixian Formation, the Lujiatun Member, below the rocks where similar early dromaeosaurids (such as Sinornithosaurus and Microraptor) were found.

facts.statement: Graciliraptor was later classified within the subfamily Microraptorinae.
facts.quote: Later it was placed in the Microraptorinae.

facts.statement: Graciliraptor lived during the early Cretaceous Period, approximately 136 to 122 million years ago in the Barremian stage in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 136 y 122 millones de años, en el Barremiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Due to its phylogenetic position, it is highly probable that Graciliraptor was covered in feathers.
facts.quote: Por su posición filogenética es muy probable que estuviera cubierto de plumas.

facts.statement: Graciliraptor exhibits basal bird-like characteristics, including elongated tail vertebrae, a small semilunar carpal contacting metacarpal II, and a very short first finger.
facts.quote: Presenta características que lo une con las aves basales, como las vértebras caudales alongadas, el carpal semilunar pequeño y contactando con el metacarpal II, con un dedo I muy corto.

facts.statement: Distinctive features of Graciliraptor include a laminar structure connecting extremely long and slender central tail vertebrae, a small claw I, a strongly expanded distal metacarpal, a rectangular tibiotarsal proximal shaft, an enlarged posterior intermediate astragalar condyle, a metatarsal II much wider distally than others, and a slender foot phalanx III-1.
facts.quote: Las características distintivas de Graciliraptor incluyen una estructura laminar que conecta s vértebras centro caudales , que son extremadamente largas y esbeltas, un hueso ungal I pequeño y el extremo distal del metacarpiano fuertemente expandido, el eje próximo del tibiotarso rectangular en la sección transversal, el condilo intermedio astragalar ampliado en la parte posterior en forma perceptible, metatarsal II mucho más ancho en distal que los otros metatarsales y la falange del pie III-1 delgada.

facts.statement: Graciliraptor is placed within the Microraptorinae alongside Bambiraptor and Microraptor.
facts.quote: Es colocado dentro de los Microraptorinae, junto con Bambiraptor y Microraptor.

facts.statement: The time range for Graciliraptor is from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)
